blurb: Guests can climb on boulders, auto-belays, and top-rope climbs with rental gear and staff assistance. The gym offers memberships with access to all locations, day passes, group climbing events, private classes, birthday parties, and overnight stays. Outdoor bouldering tours and high ropes challenge courses are also available.
extraNote: Memberships are non-refundable; annual cannot be paused except for medical reasons · Cancellation full refund if 21+ days before event; credit minus deposit if altered within 21 days; no refund within 48 hours · All visitors must sign waiver; children under 18 require parent/guardian waiver · No refunds or exchanges on climbing shoes and PPE · Day passes and memberships are non-transferable
